object.name: base
object.prompt: Create an ancient magical rune mounted on a small, solid stone pedestal, matching the exact architectural design, proportions, materials and visual style of the other Guardian Ruins runes. The pedestal is constructed from aged charcoal-gray stone, featuring masonry blocks, chipped corners, deep cracks, worn edges and subtle dark teal moss growing in small crevices. On its front-facing central surface, carve a large symmetrical diamond-shaped rune, with smaller angular markings and carefully arranged geometric lines inside the symbol. The rune emits a restrained cyan and turquoise magical glow, creating a faint blue-green illumination across the surrounding stone. Add a few delicate magical particles close to the symbol. The object must feel like an ancient protective seal created by a forgotten civilization. Side view, centered composition, complete pedestal visible, transparent background. Dark fantasy pixel art, crisp individual pixels, controlled shading and limited palette. No blur, no antialiasing, no text, no characters.
